newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said a recent Commission report stated that cars were the cheapest in The Netherlands and the most expensive in the UK. Van der Pas said differences were mainly due to exchanges rates. It is one more field where the introduction of a common currency would facilitate trade, he said.
Van der Pas said there would be a meeting in Amman on July 12-14 to discuss MED-programmes.
Van der Pas said Thursday's Commission seminar to discuss EU candidates accession had been fruitful. He confirmed that the Commission would take a final decision on Tuesday.
In answer to a question, van der Pas said the Commission would make it clear next week that EU institutional reforms would have to take place before any enlargement.
Van der Pas reminded reporters that it would be the presidency's role to negotiate accession terms with selected candidates.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/635: The annual report to the Council and to the European Parliament on the results of the multi-annual guidance programmes for the fishing fleets at the end of 1996.
- IP/97/636: The Commission renews its commitment to integrate the environment in its policy-making.
- IP/97/637: Financial services: Commissioner Monti calls on trading partners to match EU's WTO offer.
- IP/97/639: Training programme for officials working with border control, immigration and asylum.
- IP/97/640: Car prices in the EU on May 1,1997 - price differences reach record level due to revaluation of pound sterling.
- Speech/97/158: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler on partnership for sustainable rural development in Europe.
- Speech/97/159: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler on the future of beef producers in the EU.
- Memo/97/69: EU institutions calendar for July 14-18, 1997.
